rows.title: L1 microintelligence family (primitive basal circuits)
rows.intended_function: Small deterministic basal mechanisms beneath organ-level cognition: feedback control, molecular micro-agents, anomaly patterning; the 22 named primitives are rows L1-P01..P22.
rows.current_canonical_implementation: GREG micro family (setpoint solver) plus deterministic primitives inside gates, routing, contracts and organs; cortex primitive_basal profiles remain reserved/disabled.
rows.substrate: Python stdlib; numpy where already required; no model vendor.
rows.input_contract: Per-primitive typed inputs; micro family profile declares inputs/outputs/abstention.
rows.output_contract: Deterministic values or pattern_evidence artifacts inside the shared receipt envelope.
rows.epistemic_type: physical / arithmetic / pattern per primitive; never promoted beyond evidence.
rows.verifier: Unit tests per consuming mechanism; genome registration rejects reserved-family enablement and uncompiled biological vocabulary.
rows.integration_path: Keep primitives inside existing organs and GREG families; promote any basal cortex profile only through the reserved gate, never as a second routing plane.
rows.routing_eligibility: Micro family eligible through GREG catalog; cortex basal profiles withheld (reserved).
rows.blocker: Cortex basal activation requires founder attach and measured demand; no external outcome rows exist.
rows.next_build: None ahead of queued organ work; keep A02 reserved until a real deficit names a basal circuit.
rows.dependency: Founder attach for cortex reserved profiles; real outcomes for any activation decision.
rows.completion_criterion: Each named primitive has a callable, tested canonical home (tracked per primitive row); basal profiles stay disabled until their named gates clear.

rows.title: Primitive: exact arithmetic
rows.intended_function: Exact numeric calculation without floating-point drift where exactness is required.
rows.current_canonical_implementation: GREG exact solver (sympy) and Z3 arithmetic inside the formal organ.
rows.input_contract: Expression or arithmetic constraints in the family/organ input schema.
rows.output_contract: Exact value or formal model artifact with proof class exact_calculation / formal_model.
rows.epistemic_type: arithmetic; deductive for constrained arithmetic.
rows.verifier: Deterministic recomputation; Z3 model checks; unit tests including polynomial real roots.
rows.integration_path: Already on the canonical GREG catalog and cortex formal path.
rows.routing_eligibility: Eligible when geometry exactness/arithmetic requires it and dependencies import.
rows.blocker: none for the primitive
rows.next_build: Broader sympy-native symbolic organ is tracked at L3-B-EXACT (B06), not here.
rows.completion_criterion: Met: exact arithmetic is callable and tested; maintain with regression tests.

rows.title: Primitive: symbolic transformation
rows.intended_function: Rewrite, simplify and manipulate symbolic expressions exactly.
rows.current_canonical_implementation: sympy-backed exact family handles calculation and polynomial roots; no general symbolic-rewrite cortex organ is enabled.
rows.input_contract: Exact family expression/polynomial payloads.
rows.output_contract: Exact calculation artifacts; no untyped rewrite claims.
rows.epistemic_type: arithmetic.
rows.verifier: Exact recomputation and family unit tests.
rows.integration_path: Extend through the reserved cortex.exact.symbolic profile (B06), not a parallel solver registry.
rows.routing_eligibility: GREG exact family eligible; symbolic cortex organ withheld.
rows.blocker: Full transformation coverage is unbuilt; reserved organ needs its qualification gate.
rows.next_build: L3-B-EXACT next_build (sympy-native exact-symbolic organ behind the reserved gate).
rows.completion_criterion: Symbolic simplification/equality/rewrite cases pass exactness tests behind one canonical organ with typed abstention.

rows.title: Primitive: comparison
rows.intended_function: Deterministic ordering and equality/inequality comparisons used by gates and selection.
rows.current_canonical_implementation: Hard cognitive gates compare eligibility/budget/consequence fields; Pareto comparison in route ranking; frozen cross-geometry comparison in evaluation.
rows.input_contract: Typed geometry, genome and candidate fields.
rows.output_contract: Boolean gate outcomes and ordered candidates with why_not explanations.
rows.epistemic_type: deductive (structure), not empirical.
rows.verifier: Gate and routing unit tests; incomparable candidates remain incomparable rather than forced into a total order.
rows.integration_path: Canonical gates/routing modules only.
rows.routing_eligibility: Internal primitive of the router; not separately routable.
rows.blocker: none
rows.next_build: Cost-aware tie-breaking is tracked at L5-COGNITIVE-ROUTING (B32/B64).
rows.completion_criterion: Met for deterministic comparisons; any learned comparison remains outcome-gated.

rows.title: Primitive: classification
rows.intended_function: Assign problems and artifacts to typed classes without silent coercion.
rows.current_canonical_implementation: ProblemGeometry epistemic/claim/consequence classification in routing; EpistemicClass including unresolved for classification failure.
rows.input_contract: Problem payloads and geometry fields with enum validation.
rows.output_contract: Typed geometry; unresolved preserved when classification fails.
rows.epistemic_type: deductive typing; semantic only when a sourced semantic organ supplies it.
rows.verifier: Contract validation and routing tests; mutation checks.
rows.integration_path: Canonical contracts; any new classifier must emit the same enums.
rows.routing_eligibility: Internal to intake/routing.
rows.blocker: Free-text classification beyond literal intake needs the live local model (R05.1).
rows.next_build: B29 geometry fields extend classification inputs; see L5-PROBLEMGEOMETRY.
rows.dependency: Optional local semantic model for non-literal intake.
rows.completion_criterion: Met for typed intake; unresolved is never coerced into a confident class.

rows.title: Primitive: extraction
rows.intended_function: Extract structured fields from source material without inventing content.
rows.current_canonical_implementation: Schedule-extraction organ (controlled grammar to formal constraints) and semantic organ constrained to exact quoted spans with model abstention.
rows.substrate: Python stdlib; optional loopback local model for semantic spans.
rows.input_contract: Controlled schedule grammar; source text plus schema for semantic extraction.
rows.output_contract: Typed extraction artifacts consumable by formal organs; sourced claims with spans.
rows.epistemic_type: semantic; downstream constraint_feasibility only after composition.
rows.verifier: Round-trip schedule composition tests; semantic abstention when model unavailable; no unquoted claims.
rows.integration_path: Already composed through 0.4.0 bounded composition on the canonical router.
rows.routing_eligibility: Schedule extraction eligible; semantic eligible only with configured local model else abstains.
rows.blocker: General free-text extraction needs reachable founder model infrastructure (R05.1).
rows.next_build: Keep deterministic layer; no paid fallback.
rows.dependency: Local model endpoint for semantic extraction.
rows.completion_criterion: Extraction never emits unsourced fields; live-model path tested against real local infrastructure when available.

rows.title: Primitive: normalization
rows.intended_function: Canonicalize artifacts so digests, comparisons and receipts are stable.
rows.current_canonical_implementation: Canonical JSON (sorted keys, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False) and SHA-256 digests in cognition contracts; frozen manifests pin inputs.
rows.input_contract: JSON-serializable contract objects.
rows.output_contract: Canonical bytes and content digests.
rows.epistemic_type: deductive.
rows.verifier: Digest equality checks across tests and delivery verification; NaN rejected.
rows.integration_path: Shared by receipts, memory, evaluation freeze manifests.
rows.routing_eligibility: Internal primitive.
rows.blocker: none
rows.completion_criterion: Met: one canonicalization function is reused rather than per-organ variants.

rows.title: Primitive: threshold detection
rows.intended_function: Detect crossings of declared numeric/categorical thresholds for gates, scoring and health.
rows.current_canonical_implementation: Gate thresholds, evaluation scoring thresholds, competence-ledger confidence thresholds and cell health transitions.
rows.input_contract: Declared thresholds plus typed measurements.
rows.output_contract: Boolean/threshold-state outcomes recorded in receipts or scores.
rows.epistemic_type: deductive over declared measurements.
rows.verifier: Unit tests for gates and ledger refusal below evidence thresholds.
rows.integration_path: Canonical gates/evaluation/memory only.
rows.routing_eligibility: Internal primitive.
rows.blocker: none
rows.completion_criterion: Met; thresholds must remain declared, not tuned to hide failures.

rows.title: Primitive: constraint checking
rows.intended_function: Check assignments/models against explicit constraints and produce witnesses or UNSAT.
rows.current_canonical_implementation: Z3 formal organ and OR-Tools CP-SAT formed organ with independent re-check; GREG formal family.
rows.input_contract: Formal model schemas (variables, constraints, objective where present).
rows.output_contract: SAT/UNSAT, witness, formal_model or optimization_certificate artifacts.
rows.epistemic_type: deductive / constraint_feasibility.
rows.verifier: Second engine re-check, UNSAT optimality certificates, brute force on small instances, mutation checks.
rows.integration_path: Canonical formal/optimization organs; formed functions only through existing attach path.
rows.routing_eligibility: Eligible under formal/optimization geometry with complete formalization; otherwise FORMALIZATION_INCOMPLETE.
rows.blocker: none for supported theories; extensions tracked at L3-D-FORMAL (B07).
rows.completion_criterion: Met for current theories; witnesses independently checked and failures preserved.

rows.title: Primitive: scoring
rows.intended_function: Score candidates and evaluation arms against frozen rubrics.
rows.current_canonical_implementation: Evaluation scoring across suites and cross-geometry comparisons; route scores remain subordinate to hard gates.
rows.input_contract: Frozen suite items and arm outputs.
rows.output_contract: Deterministic scores and comparison records; NOT_RUN for unavailable arms.
rows.epistemic_type: deductive scoring over generated evaluation evidence, not external truth.
rows.verifier: Freeze-manifest refusal on changed inputs; cross-geometry tests; no simulated baselines.
rows.integration_path: Canonical evaluation plane; scores feed no authority.
rows.routing_eligibility: Evaluation-only; not an organ.
rows.real_world_evidence: none — evaluation scores are not field outcomes.
rows.blocker: LLM arms NOT_RUN without local model.
rows.next_build: N1 comparisons remain n1_dependent; see CANONICAL-N1-MINIMAL-PROOF.
rows.completion_criterion: Met for deterministic scoring; external validity requires real outcomes.

rows.title: Primitive: ranking
rows.intended_function: Order eligible candidates honestly after hard eligibility.
rows.current_canonical_implementation: Deterministic route ranking with Pareto incomparability, alternatives why_not, and outcome-conditional ledger reorder that refuses without evidence.
rows.input_contract: Eligible candidate set plus geometry and optional competence estimates.
rows.output_contract: Ordered route/composition plus explicit alternatives and cap_dropped records.
rows.epistemic_type: deductive; outcome-conditioned estimates labeled separately.
rows.verifier: Routing tests including cap honesty and freeze non-contamination; ledger tests refuse unearned reordering.
rows.integration_path: One router; no second ranking plane.
rows.routing_eligibility: Internal to router.
rows.blocker: Outcome-based ranking has zero real outcome rows (R12.2).
rows.completion_criterion: Met for deterministic ranking; learned ranking only after measured outcomes.

rows.title: Primitive: state transition
rows.intended_function: Explicit, auditable lifecycle and health transitions.
rows.current_canonical_implementation: Genome registration states (including SUPERSEDED lineage), cell AVAILABLE/DEGRADED/DETACHED health, ledger rollback, receipt state serialization.
rows.input_contract: Typed state records and transition events.
rows.output_contract: New typed state with preserved lineage; no deletion of superseded records.
rows.epistemic_type: deductive.
rows.verifier: Genome/ledger/cell unit tests; rollback tests.
rows.integration_path: Canonical registry, journal projections and memory.
rows.routing_eligibility: Internal primitive.
rows.blocker: none
rows.completion_criterion: Met; transitions never create authority.

rows.title: Primitive: pattern matching
rows.intended_function: Detect matches/anomalies as pattern evidence without claiming causation.
rows.current_canonical_implementation: GREG pattern family anomalies solver; cortex.pattern.anomaly and basal anomaly patterning reserved.
rows.input_contract: Pattern family observation payloads.
rows.output_contract: pattern_evidence artifacts; epistemically separate from causal identification.
rows.epistemic_type: prediction / pattern, never causal by default.
rows.verifier: Family unit tests; cortex activation blocked pending attach/evidence.
rows.integration_path: Promote only via reserved cortex.pattern.anomaly gate if a real deficit demands it.
rows.routing_eligibility: GREG pattern family eligible; cortex pattern organ withheld.
rows.blocker: Cortex pattern activation needs founder attach and evaluation evidence (A15/B16).
rows.completion_criterion: Primitive met at GREG level; cortex-level completion defined on L3-O-PATTERN.

rows.title: Primitive: uncertainty representation
rows.intended_function: Represent confidence, intervals, distributions and ignorance distinctly.
rows.current_canonical_implementation: Bounded estimates with dependent-input copula uncertainty and sensitivity; Beta posteriors; unresolved epistemic class; world_confidence null without outcomes.
rows.input_contract: Estimate decompositions, priors/observations, typed confidence fields.
rows.output_contract: bounded_estimate / posterior artifacts with explicit assumptions; null world confidence when unmeasured.
rows.epistemic_type: estimate / prediction; ignorance remains unresolved, not a tight distribution.
rows.verifier: Estimation and cognition tests; freeze manifests for reported comparisons.
rows.integration_path: Canonical estimation/probabilistic families and contracts.
rows.routing_eligibility: Eligible through their families; Bayesian cortex organ reserved.
rows.real_world_evidence: none — no calibration against external outcomes.
rows.blocker: Calibration requires real outcomes.
rows.completion_criterion: Met representationally; calibrated uncertainty remains unproven until outcomes exist.

rows.title: Primitive: evidence attribution
rows.intended_function: Bind claims to the evidence and provenance that support them.
rows.current_canonical_implementation: Evidence/causal organ provenance rules, receipt accountability (strongest counterargument, falsification condition, missing resolving information), shared-dependency recording in verifier.
rows.substrate: Python stdlib; numpy/scipy for bootstrap where used.
rows.input_contract: Evidence items with provenance and claim bindings.
rows.output_contract: Attributed claims, contradictions, NOT_IDENTIFIED where evidence cannot identify causation.
rows.epistemic_type: causal only when identified; otherwise estimate/prediction/unresolved.
rows.verifier: Adversarial verifier blocks recommend on critical findings; causal unit tests.
rows.integration_path: Canonical evidence organ and receipt envelope.
rows.routing_eligibility: Evidence organ eligible under causal/evidence geometry; attribution fields mandatory on receipts.
rows.blocker: none for attribution mechanics; evidence supply is external.
rows.dependency: Real evidence sources for external claims.
rows.completion_criterion: Met mechanically; no claim may silently lose its provenance.

rows.title: Primitive: provenance
rows.intended_function: Preserve origin and lineage of artifacts, routes and records.
rows.current_canonical_implementation: Repository provenance/ package, receipt provenance fields, genome lineage including superseded profiles, freeze manifests and delivery blob/tree verification.

rows.input_contract: Artifacts and source references.
rows.output_contract: Provenance records and digests retained in receipts/runs.
rows.epistemic_type: deductive record-keeping.
rows.verifier: Traceability/register tests; fresh-clone replication record.
rows.integration_path: Canonical provenance and evidence system; no parallel store.
rows.routing_eligibility: Internal primitive.
rows.real_world_evidence: Remote replication of the 0.4.0 branch is independently repeated execution evidence, not a commercial outcome.
rows.blocker: none
rows.completion_criterion: Met; negative provenance (failed runs) is retained alongside passes.

rows.title: Primitive: verification
rows.intended_function: Independently check solver outputs before higher dispositions.
rows.current_canonical_implementation: Adversarial verifier, second-engine re-checks, UNSAT/duality certificates, brute force on small instances, repository verifier v4 six-layer checks.

rows.output_contract: Findings, certificates, verified/blocked dispositions.
rows.epistemic_type: deductive verification; empirical validity kept separate from formal validity.
rows.verifier: Verifier is itself tested by mutation checks and failing-then-passing preserved runs.
rows.integration_path: One verifier path on receipts; independent replication recorded under verifier/runs.
rows.routing_eligibility: Mandatory post-solver stage, not optional routing candidate.
rows.real_world_evidence: Fresh-clone replication passed 1833/6/0; earlier flake record preserved.
rows.blocker: Verification cannot establish external truth or authority.
rows.next_build: More structurally different checkers under L5-COGNITIVE-DEGENERACY.
rows.completion_criterion: Met for supported artifact types; new organs must ship a verifier before eligibility.

rows.output_contract: Contradiction findings, UNSAT, blocked/CONTESTED outcomes.
rows.epistemic_type: deductive for formal contradiction; evidence conflict remains typed, not resolved by vote.
rows.verifier: Unit tests for contradictions and critical-finding blocks.
rows.integration_path: Feeds L5-METACONSENSUS next build; no averaging layer.
rows.routing_eligibility: Internal to evidence/verifier/formal paths.
rows.blocker: Cross-organ verdict-typed metaconsensus not yet built (B30).
rows.completion_criterion: Primitive met; completion of cross-organ handling is measured on the metaconsensus row.

rows.title: L2 bounded competency cells
rows.directive_ref: L2 bounded competency cells; review A03/B04
rows.intended_function: Replaceable competency envelopes with input/output contracts, epistemic type, boundary, cost, latency, evidence requirements, verifier, failure modes, abstention, provenance and tests; outcome-conditioned cells projected from the canonical body.
rows.current_canonical_implementation: CognitiveCapabilityProfile envelopes and catalog manifests for every built-in family/cortex entry; greg/cognition/cells.py projects measured_outcomes by (method, version, geometry) using only the canonical journal (last 32 observation references), budget money_usd=0, 30s/2GiB, authority_ceiling read_only, world_confidence null without outcomes.
rows.substrate: Python stdlib profiles; existing journal/registry; no second store, no model vendor.
rows.input_contract: Per-cell declared inputs plus geometry and evidence requirements; cells refuse out-of-contract work.
rows.output_contract: Typed family artifacts in one receipt envelope; cell health and local predicate rate, never external calibration claims.
rows.epistemic_type: Declared per cell from EpistemicClass; unresolved preserved.
rows.verifier: Per-cell verifier plus unit/integration tests; cells DETACHED when unusable, DEGRADED after failures.
rows.integration_path: Cells remain projections of the existing body; escalation uses existing mission deficit/authority/founder paths; no autonomous goal pursuit or self-enlargement.
rows.routing_eligibility: Only registered, healthy, contract-matching cells; zero real outcomes means no outcome-trained cell population is active.
rows.real_world_evidence: none — zero real outcome rows (R12.2); projection existence is not an active trained population.
rows.blocker: B04 remaining CognitiveProfile fields unbuilt; outcome-conditioned behavior awaits real outcomes.
rows.next_build: Add remaining B04 profile fields with validation and tests, after higher-leverage queued VOI/metaconsensus work or if reprioritized by the matrix.
rows.dependency: Canonical journal and registry; real outcomes for conditioning; B04 schema design.
rows.completion_criterion: Every registered capability carries the full directive cell envelope, validated by schema tests, and any outcome-conditioned claim is backed by actual canonical outcome records.
